cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

mechanism: Copy a host's cup-wrapping without understanding it is disposal, then make each warmer gift sound like a more permanent farewell.
confusable: Not simply asking a guest to leave: the misunderstood copied packing must shape caring gifts whose wording grows more final despite B's reassurance.
comparison: A recurring visitor and borrowed teacup differ from a short journey and increasingly permanent food provision.
seedUse: Retains good teacup/afternoons/future doors; replaces abstract doorway language with actual packing and promised return.
